title: Find, understand, and organize your files with private local AI
subtitle: Find what you need, understand what you have, and keep every file organized.
description: Sift is a private local file copilot for natural-language search, multimodal retrieval, and content-aware organization on macOS.

hero.alt: Sift organizes a cluttered folder into useful categories with clearer filenames
hero.caption: Sift turns a cluttered folder into a coherent structure with clearer names.

abstract: Sift helps you find a file when you remember its meaning but not its name. It searches filenames, document contents, and indexed images, then shows the evidence behind every result.

Sift can also make sense of a cluttered folder, propose a useful structure, and follow plain-language requests to move or rename files. It brings search, organization, and local AI models together in one simple app.

highlights.label: Files and models stay on your Mac
Preview and refine changes before applying them

sections.title: Find what you remember
sections.lead: Ask in your own words and verify the evidence behind every result.

blocks.text: Search for a topic, an invoice, a paper, or a half-remembered phrase. Sift retrieves relevant files even when your wording does not match the filename, then shows the matching document text so you can confirm the result.

blocks.alt: Sift finds a relevant document from a natural-language question
blocks.caption: Natural-language retrieval over filenames and document contents.

sections.title: Search what is inside an image
sections.lead: Make screenshots searchable by visible text and visual context, not only by filename.

blocks.text: Enable image reading during a scan and a local vision model can index screenshots and photos. This makes it possible to find a slide, receipt, chart, or captured conversation from what appears inside it.

blocks.alt: Sift finds a screenshot by the text and visual content inside it
blocks.caption: Multimodal retrieval powered by a local vision model.

sections.title: Organize with a sentence
sections.lead: Clean up a whole folder or describe exactly what you want done.

blocks.text: Sift looks at the complete batch and proposes categories, subfolders, and clearer filenames together. You can also ask it to move, rename, group, or trash files in plain English, then see the result in a clear before-and-after view.

blocks.alt: Sift converts a plain-language request into organized file moves
blocks.caption: A plain-language instruction moves related files where they belong.

sections.title: Start with one double-click
sections.lead: The initial release supports macOS and creates a familiar app icon for everyday use.

blocks.html:
1. Install and open Ollama.
  2. Download Sift from GitHub, then unzip the folder.
  3. Double-click Install Sift.command once to download the default local models and prepare the app.
  4. Open Sift from the blue Sift.app icon revealed in Finder.

blocks.text: Sift currently integrates with Finder, the macOS Trash, and a native macOS launcher. Windows and Linux are not officially supported in this initial release.
